name: Reflected Rival
description: Operate only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state access, or unrelated tabs. Win the visible two-racer course by steering the white racer ahead of the blue mirror.
natural_language: Operate only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state access, or unrelated tabs. metadata.source_notes: Grounded in the supplied XART-051 Mirror Racer record and its js1024 readme/source: one left/right input is mirrored onto a blue opponent, and asymmetric green boost and red slow terrain determines the race. The two-racer course, generated terrain, interface pair, art, and independent replay are original adaptations; no source assets or code are copied.
metadata.notes: Baseline is L4/full/live. The browser exposes visible terrain, both racers, and progress; the server and exported verifier independently replay every mirrored lane change and forward-motion tick. No client completion or private route claim is trusted.
